sources.title: Wikipedia: Aristotle
sources.description: Ancient Greek philosopher and polymath (384–322 BC)

notes.text: Aristotle was an ancient Greek philosopher and polymath.
Aristotle's writings span the natural sciences, philosophy, linguistics, economics, politics, psychology, and the arts.
Aristotle is remembered as a philosopher connected with Greece.
Aristotle's recorded life dates place this profile around -384--321.
Aristotle is grouped with Philosophy, Ethics & Religion in the People Library.
